turns.answer:
My recommendation: Get the Garmin Approach S72. It's probably the best match for someone who plays golf on weekends but wants one watch for everyday fitness, workouts, and sleep tracking.

There's actually a new generation worth considering: Garmin released the Approach S72 in October 2026, replacing the S70.

Why I'd choose the S72

The S72 has some particularly interesting upgrades:

On-course: More than 43,000 golf courses, swing metrics, putting analytics and enhanced golf insights.

During workouts: Strength, mobility, driving range and other activity tracking.

At night: Sleep tracking, sleep insights, heart rate and recovery-related metrics.

Everyday: AMOLED display, built-in flashlight, speaker and microphone.

One important distinction: the fēnix 8 offers more advanced athletic training analytics, while the S72 puts more emphasis on golf.
